faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 29 October 2026. The documents to bring are given in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HLL Lifecare Limited, Kanagala.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Graduate Trainee (BSc): maximum 35 years; Graduate Apprenticeship: maximum 30 years; Technician Apprenticeship: maximum 30 years; ITI Trade Apprenticeship: maximum 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹13000 to ₹15500 per month for Graduate Trainee (BSc), ₹12,300 per month for Graduate Apprenticeship, ₹10,900 per month for Technician Apprenticeship, ₹9,600 per month for ITI Trade Apprenticeship.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: BSc, BE/B.Tech, Diploma, ITI. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Age relaxation will be given to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Govt. of India rules. The training will not confer on them any claim for regular employment.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already undergone training in the Company under these schemes.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Training period for Training and Development Scheme (TDS) is for 3 years. Training period for Apprenticeship Scheme is one year.
